# m.stocks.imbalances

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Net order imbalances of US-listed stocks ahead of opening and closing auctions.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.imbalances(symbols, *, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `blink()`, `append_only()`, `ring(capacity)`, `last_by(by='Symbol')`
- Read from: WebSocket

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers, or `dm.ALL` for every ticker. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Net Order Imbalance (NOI) (WebSocket) |

| Stocks Basic | Not included |
| Stocks Starter | Not included |
| Stocks Developer | Not included |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From WebSocket `T`: "The ticker symbol for the given stock." |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `Timestamp`. |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's event time. From WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix Ns." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When the session's `unreadable_symbols` (`MassiveConfig.on_error`) is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, the column is absent, and such a row fails the table unless the call's own `on_error` keeps it. |
| `AuctionTime` | long | The time that the auction is planned to take place in the format (hour x 100) + minutes in Eastern Standard Time, for example 930 would be 9:30 am EST, and 1600 would be 4:00 pm EST. |
| `AuctionType` | String | The auction type. `O` - Early Opening Auction (non-NYSE only) `M` - Core Opening Auction `H` - Reopening Auction (Halt Resume) `C` - Closing Auction `P` - Extreme Closing Imbalance (NYSE only) `R` - Regulatory Closing Imbalance (NYSE only) |
| `SymbolSequence` | long | The symbol sequence. |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. |
| `ImbalanceQuantity` | long | The imbalance quantity. |
| `PairedQuantity` | long | The paired quantity. |
| `BookClearingPrice` | double | The book clearing price. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. |
